reason: The icon-only dismiss-all button in the Updates popover header exposes menuitem "" [disabled=true]: no aria-label, no title, an empty hidden-label span and an aria-hidden icon, so 4.1.2 fails on name. Its xpath is now body/div[6], not div[5], because a portal was added; rect, classes and tree entry match the sweep's. It is disabled and the popover reads No updates, so nobody has anything to act on in the sampled state; the enabled state needs updates the demo does not have, so I rate it low.
